sources.snippet: My research focuses on multilingual and multimodal NLP, particularly on how models represent lexical meaning in Ukrainian. I build datasets and benchmarks for word-sense disambiguation and develop data-efficient methods for adapting sentence and vision-language models when annotated data are limited. sources.title: GitHub - YuriiLaba/U-WSD
sources.snippet: The model was validated on a WSD dataset based on the СЛОВНИК УКРАЇНСЬКОЇ МОВИ. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first dataset used to validate the WSD task in Ukrainian. ConEFU can be utilized to generate high-quality embeddings for the Ukrainian language. It is available on Hugging Face.
